coordinateUnits: Raw OpenF1 Cartesian source units; OpenF1 documents x/y/z without a physical unit.
anchorConvention: Twelve evenly spaced closed-loop planar fractions after normalizePositions, source rotation, closure, and toTrackPoints3D cleanup.

quality.method: Direction-aware median of archived race telemetry near each cleaned canonical point; five-point circular median; linear-error simplification.
